candidates.defensive_rotation: 100% SPMO while close above trailing200-session mean; otherwise hold the stronger trailing63-session positive-return asset among GLD and IEF; if neither positive, cash; monthly close decision,next-open fill
candidates.diversified_trend: fixed 60% SPMO,20% GLD,20% IEF; each slot invested only if asset close exceeds its trailing200-session mean; monthly first-session close, next-open fill
candidates.vol_scaled: SPMO target exposure min(1,15% / trailing63-session annual volatility), weekly first-session close, next-open fill

cash: previous observed IRX pro rata elapsed days
limitations: new fixed designs on previously researched history; not a pristine holdout; no parameters changed after evaluation; actual fund prices include fund expenses
selection: highest development net CAGR among candidates with drawdown no deeper than30% and positive stress excess mean
